claim: Patient-level generalization is measured without giving a ranker credit when candidate generation loses the causal hypothesis.

metric_contract.candidate_generation_recall: Fraction of cases whose exact causal hypothesis reaches the ranker.
metric_contract.end_to_end_top_k: Missing causal hypotheses count as failures.
metric_contract.conditional_top1: Ranking accuracy only among cases whose causal hypothesis survived candidate generation.
metric_contract.calibration: Per-case non-negative scores are normalized across retained hypotheses before NLL and Brier calculation.
metric_contract.ood: AUROC of top-ranked-hypothesis uncertainty for distinguishing unseen from seen causal genes.
